==========================================================================================================================
THIS APP WAS GENERALLY DESIGNED TO ENABLE DayZ GAMERS TO VERY EASILY SET UP A PRIVATE LAN SERVER. HOWEVER, I DECIDED TO ADD ANOTHER ADDITIONAL FEATURE TO THE LAN Launcher APP,
SO THAT USERS WILL ALSO BE ABLE TO JOIN ANY TYPE OF PUBLIC SERVER BY USING THE TRIANGULAR SHAPED DSC BUTTON. SO THIS LAUNCHER IS INDEED A TRULY USEFUL LAUNCHER.

1. LAN SERVERS

2. PUBLIC OFFICIAL SERVERS

3. COMMUNITY SERVERS

4. EXPERIMENTAL SERVERS
=============================================================================================================================

==========================================================================================================================
// SOMETHING ELSE VERY IMPORTANT: WHEN YOU LAUNCH A SERVER MAP, A SMALL POP UP WINDOW WILL APPEAR IN THE LEFT UPPER CORNER OF YOUR MONITOR SCREEN.

IT WILL SAY, DayZ Console version (64 bit). WHEN THE POP UP WINDOW IS FINSHED DOWNLOADING IT'S DATA, IT WILL SAY, "Init sequence finished."

IT IS VERY IMPORTANT THAT YOU LET THE DayZ Console POP UP WINDOW FINISH LOADING IT'S DATA BEFORE YOU CLICK THE PLAY BUTTON AT STEAM, OTHERWISE LAN Laucher WILL CRASH. //
==========================================================================================================================

// WHEN YOU CLICK ONE OF THE SERVER MAPS (THERE ARE 7 OF THEM) AND THEN CLICK THE LAUNCH BUTTON, YOU WILL SEE A SMALL POP UP WINDOW APPEAR ON THE LEFT UPPER AREA OF THE PC MONITOR SCREEN. 
THE POP UP WILL BE THE DayZ Console (64bit). YOU ABSOLUTELY MUST WAIT UNTIL ALL OF THE DATA IN THIS WINDOW IS FINISHED LOADING. WHEN IT IS FINISHED LOADING, YOU SHOULD SEE SOMETHING THAT SAYS
Init Save Finished. THAT IS USUALLY WHAT IT WILL SAY. THEN YOU ARE READY TO CLICK PLAY IN STEAM. //
